evidence.detail: R55 DrawingArea owns the global float[] depth buffer and int[] framebuffer. rs/l/d walks those exact arrays over the active DrawingArea width/height.

For each pixel, the renderer compares depth against caller-supplied near/far thresholds, replaces pixels beyond the far threshold with a configured RGB fog color, and alpha-like blends that fog color across the near-to-far interval.
The interpolation uses separate red/blue and green packed-channel masks with an 8-bit 0..256 blend factor, producing the canonical depth-fog fade into the target color.
The class owns one float offset added to both supplied depth thresholds plus one static fog color, matching a configurable depth-fog pass rather than generic post-processing.

No surviving exact-v308 external direct class owner invokes rs/l/d. The class is therefore semantically recoverable from its self-contained raster behavior but is not claimed as active in the live render path.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the dormant depth-buffer fog blending pass. No original stripped source identifier is claimed.
